overview.description: The JPMorgan California Tax Free Bond ETF (JCAL) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in broad credit fixed income. The fund is an actively managed diversified portfolio of intermediate term California municipal bonds. The portfolio tilts towards investment grade securities but allocates to below-investment grade as well JCAL was launched on Jun 12, 2026 and is issued by JPMorgan Chase.
